snippet.title: Crux Diaries RPG: Isometric Turn-Based CRPG Trailer (04.2025)
snippet.description:
A turn-based isometric non-linear indie CRPG inspired by the classics.
Wishlist on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3302370/Crux_Diaries_RPG/?utm_source=youtube

Explore an alternate-history dystopian country on the brink of a civil war and leave your mark on its future.

Soundtrack: "Unknown Universe" by Serge Pavkin Music (C) Pixabay license
